summary: H.R. 5351, the NSF AI Education Act of 2025, directs the National Science Foundation (NSF) to establish various programs to promote education, scholarships, fellowships, and research related to artificial intelligence (AI). It supports undergraduate and graduate student scholarships, professional development fellowships for educators and industry professionals, regional centers of AI excellence at community colleges and technical schools, research grants for K-12 AI integration, and a pilot mentoring program for school leaders.

affected_groups.effect: May receive scholarships and fellowships covering tuition, fees, stipends, and professional development funds for up to five years.
Eligible for professional development fellowships, peer support mentoring programs, and training to integrate AI into classrooms.
May host Centers of AI Excellence to drive workforce development and establish regional best practices.
Eligible to apply for merit-based research awards regarding AI teaching models and educational outcomes.
Can receive fellowships for short-term appointments to instruct students on AI applications.

key_provisions: Authorizes NSF to award scholarships and fellowships to undergraduate and graduate students focusing on AI, with prioritization for advanced manufacturing, agriculture, and teaching fields.
Provides professional development fellowships for students, faculty, K-12 teachers, school counselors, and short-term industry professionals to teach or study AI.
Establishes up to eight regionally diverse Community College and Area Career and Technical Education Centers of AI Excellence.
Authorizes merit-based research grants to higher education institutions and nonprofits to study AI teaching models and K-12 classroom integration.
Creates a pilot program of regional cohorts to provide peer support, mentoring, and research experiences for K-12 educators and school leaders.
missing_information: Specific funding amounts or authorized dollar appropriations are not mentioned in the source text.
Exact timelines for when the scholarship and grant programs must launch are not provided beyond reporting deadlines.
summary_detail.plain_summary: H.R. 5351, the NSF AI Education Act of 2025, directs the National Science Foundation (NSF) to establish various programs to promote education, scholarships, fellowships, and research related to artificial intelligence (AI). It supports undergraduate and graduate student scholarships, professional development fellowships for educators and industry professionals, regional centers of AI excellence at community colleges and technical schools, research grants for K-12 AI integration, and a pilot mentoring program for school leaders.
summary_detail.significance: This bill directs federal science and education funding toward integrating artificial intelligence into classrooms and workforce training programs nationwide. By targeting community colleges, K-12 schools, and higher education through coordinated grants, centers of excellence, and specialized fellowships, the legislation aims to expand the nation's AI-ready talent pool across multiple education levels.
